news.title: UI honors 2026 Hawkeye Distinguished Veterans Award recipients
news.summary_en: The University of Iowa is honoring four Veterans and members of the UI community with the 2026 Hawkeye Distinguished Veterans Award.

news.title: No place like home: Hawkeyes come together for Homecoming 2026
news.summary_en: Iowa City was the place to be as Hawkeyes near and far gathered for a memorable Homecoming celebration featuring beloved traditions, familiar faces, plenty of black and gold pride — and a bit of rain. Whether you joined the festivities in person or want to relive the fun, check out the highlights in this photo gallery and recap video below.

news.title: UI seeks approval for Developmental Studies Hybridoma Bank facility improvements
news.summary_en: The University of Iowa is seeking approval from the Iowa Board of Regents at its November meeting to renovate the Biology Building's north wing, creating a dedicated space for its internationally recognized Developmental Studies Hybridoma Bank (DSHB).

news.title: UI seeks approval for IMU footbridge renovations
news.summary_en: The University of Iowa is seeking approval from the Iowa Board of Regents at its November meeting to renovate the Iowa Memorial Union (IMU) footbridge, replacing aging decking and railings and making other improvements to extend the bridge's life.

news.title: Viewing the world through Hawkeye eyes
news.summary_en: This year's International Education Month photo contest drew nearly 500 entries, capturing moments from study abroad programs, international research projects, internships, service experiences, and cultural exchanges around the world.

news.title: TRACERS mission extended to spring 2027
news.summary_en: NASA has extended the University of Iowa-led TRACERS mission to spring 2027, giving scientists the needed time to fulfill the mission’s goals. The extension means both spacecraft will be able to collect data to answer fundamental questions about how charged particles from the sun, called the solar wind, interact with Earth and its protective magnetic field.
